parent_v12.key_result: 12 random topology worlds with identical static A/B/M/G/marginal maps usually differed in pairwise relations, first-passage and intervention targets

parent_v11.key_result: in four hand-designed topology worlds, narrow targets required only one or two relational measurements while the joint target became topology-identifying

scientific_question: How much atomic relational information is actually required to identify topology-sensitive ecological targets in random static-equivalent transition worlds, and was the very low v11 burden specific to the four archetypes?

analysis_base.worlds: exact frozen v12 random topology worlds; no new ecological worlds generated
analysis_base.static_nodewise_representation: identical within each row and excluded from optimization because v12 proved it non-discriminating

targets.critical_node_count: count of non-source nodes whose knockout disconnects another active node

exact_optimization.rule: a measurement set is target-sufficient when any worlds sharing its joint measurement signature also share the target value
exact_optimization.method: deduplicate measurements by induced partition of the 12 worlds, then exact minimum-cardinality search over partition combinations
exact_optimization.tie_rule: lexicographically smallest measurement-ID tuple among exact minima
exact_optimization.infeasible: retain as unresolved; do not add measurement types

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Every row's pairwise-relation, first-passage, intervention, critical-node-count, full-topology and joint-relational targets are resolvable by the complete REL/FP/KO library.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED separately for any target family with at least one unresolved row.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For both first-passage and intervention targets, the pooled median exact minimum measurement count across v12 rows is strictly greater than 1.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED separately for either target whose median minimum is <=1.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Across rows, pooled mean exact minimum measurement count is strictly lower for intervention than for pairwise relation.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if intervention-minus-relation mean burden is >=0.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Across row-target combinations for pairwise relation, first passage and intervention, Spearman correlation between target-class count and exact minimum measurement count is strictly positive.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if pooled Spearman correlation is <=0.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every row, joint-relational-suite minimum measurement count is >= the minimum for pairwise relation, first passage and intervention individually.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one row-target exact minimum has an equally small representative using a measurement family different from the semantic target family.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if cross-family exact minima disappear completely.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Every row's 12 edge-topology identities are resolvable by REL/FP/KO measurements without direct edge-list observation.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if any row remains topology-unresolved.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Across rows and targets, canonical exact minima contain more than one distinct first measurement ID.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if one fixed atomic measurement is always canonical first.

secondary_outputs: minimum measurement-count distributions by active-node count and target
target-class count distributions and compression relative to 12 topology identities
burden by extra-edge density characteristics of the row
fraction of atomic library needed by each target
rows where joint target and full-topology target have the same minimum design
claim_boundary: Exact measurement counts are conceptual information counts, not field sampling costs.
The 12-world random panels are controlled DAG ensembles rather than empirical dispersal networks.
A target-sufficient measurement set is only sufficient for the declared target.
No novelty is claimed for finite partition refinement or exact combinatorial search.
stop_rules: Do not add edge-list queries after scoring.
Do not change measurement costs after scoring.
Do not drop rows with high burden.
Do not reduce the target suite after scoring.
If S2 or S3 is refuted, retain the refutation rather than reverting to the four-archetype panel.
